rows.resolution_note: Rules B and C2, decision step 3: the repository name is followed in a passage of this row by the accession ebi-a-GCST90026371, which no dictionary row lists by identifier, prefix or range; the cardiomyopathy sentence gives the repository name alone and names no other release, so nothing conflicts. The accession is that of the mtDNA-CN GWAS, which the abstract's bidirectional design places on both sides; the cardiomyopathy data from the same repository carry no accession.
rows.quote: The GWAS data of the of mtDNA-CN genetic data were obtained from the IEU Open GWAS database, which is an open access database for genome-wide association studies. mtDNA-CN has a GWAS ID of ebi-a-GCST90026371, a sample size of 383,476 cases, and a number of 24,195,431 SNPs.
